body:
Weed, Alcohol, Exstacy, Coke, Percocets
So me and my homie j are just waiting to pick up our wiggles for a party we were gonna go to. While we were waitin I remeber a friend of mine gave me 4 of his percocets. I popped them and within an hour I started to feel a small head change but not much. We went and picked up our thizzles and were shocked to find out that our dealer had got the white naked ladys pills (white naked ladys are the best of the best wen it come to thizz). We then matched a blunt with our dealer. And we had some dank ass rombulin bud after the two bleezies. I was hella blown and the percocets got me feeling good by now.
About 2 hours later we chew up our pills and wait. The taste of xtc is horrible by the way. 2 hours after we arrived I was slappin hard. Like I couldnt think straight and I wanted to run. It also felt like my brain was bubblin. It was kinda weird. My homie T comes up and ask if we want to do some lines. I took a little taste of the blow and it was pretty bomb shit. So I proceeded to snort about half a gram.
By this point in the night I am flyin and nothing can bother me. Theres a keg at the party so I drank a little too much as usual. Ended up passing out in the morning.
Woke up the next day with a killer hangover. The combo was pretty cool. But the comedown sucks ass. But ill probably just drink and smoke some more to numb the pain.
